menus.note: All prices include tax. Exact event operator menu applies to the three named participating branches. Event ends November 8; Tokyo/Nagoya began October 1 and Osaka October 8. Menu photographs are shared event illustrations. Full menu checked against operator announcement, current menu, branch information, visit guide, operator gallery and landlord branch page. menus.label: Qualifying themed drinks

items.name: フラワーアップルティー

menus.note: One random paper coaster from six designs per qualifying drink. Main themed coffee is self hand-dripped. Drink limit five per person including side drinks.

menus.label: Side drinks — excluded from required order and coaster benefit
menus.note: These five side drinks do not count toward the minimum one qualifying food/dessert/drink per person and do not receive the drink coaster. Hot/iced tea are one listed item with two options.

menus.label: Seat reservation fee
menus.note: Additional to food/drink spend. Includes two-postcard set only when reserved guest actually attends and orders a menu item. Credit-card online booking by prior-day 15:00; TableCheck account required. No refund or changes after confirmation. Cancel is possible but no refund. Reserve for everyone aged four and older, and younger children needing a seat; under-four lap children need no seat reservation. Stroller used as seat counts as one person. Four seats per transaction; larger groups book separately, adjacent seating not guaranteed.

specials.title: Chainsaw Man Kissaten — limited collaboration menu
specials.description: Dated themed food, dessert and drinks menu at this exact BOX branch, with a coaster for each qualifying themed drink. Food from ¥1,190, desserts from ¥1,290, themed drinks from ¥990, tax included; advance reservation costs ¥660 extra.
specials.menuLabel: Chainsaw Man Kissaten — limited collaboration menu
conditions: Available only 2026-10-08 through 2026-11-08, Japan local dates.
75-minute seating sessions start every 45 minutes from 10:00 to 19:45; arrive ten minutes before the booked start. Twenty minutes late may cancel the reservation.
At least one qualifying food, dessert or themed drink per guest; ¥690 side drinks are excluded.
Advance booking recommended; ¥660 per person additional, no refund or changes; credit-card booking closes prior-day 15:00. Walk-in seating only if staff can accommodate; no telephone bookings.
Photo ID matching reservation required. Maximum four seats per transaction; reserve required child/stroller seats too.
One initial QR/mobile order only; no additional orders. Food maximum three, dessert maximum three, drinks including sides maximum five per person. Table-level payment; no separate bills.
Drink coaster applies only to three themed drinks, not side drinks. Reserved-guest postcard set requires actual attendance and menu order; merchandise purchase alone does not qualify.
Ingredients/presentation may change; no takeaway of served food.

Credit-card online booking by prior-day 15:00; TableCheck account required. No refund or changes after confirmation. Cancel is possible but no refund. Reserve for everyone aged four and older, and younger children needing a seat; under-four lap children need no seat reservation. Stroller used as seat counts as one person. Four seats per transaction; larger groups book separately, adjacent seating not guaranteed.

specials.title: Chainsaw Man Kissaten — limited collaboration menu
specials.description: Dated themed food, dessert and drinks menu at this exact BOX branch, with a coaster for each qualifying themed drink. Food from ¥1,190, desserts from ¥1,290, themed drinks from ¥990, tax included; advance reservation costs ¥660 extra.
specials.menuLabel: Chainsaw Man Kissaten — limited collaboration menu
conditions: Available only 2026-10-01 through 2026-11-08, Japan local dates.
75-minute seating sessions start every 45 minutes from 11:15 to 20:15; arrive ten minutes before the booked start. Twenty minutes late may cancel the reservation.
At least one qualifying food, dessert or themed drink per guest; ¥690 side drinks are excluded.
Advance booking recommended; ¥660 per person additional, no refund or changes; credit-card booking closes prior-day 15:00. Walk-in seating only if staff can accommodate; no telephone bookings.
Photo ID matching reservation required. Maximum four seats per transaction; reserve required child/stroller seats too.
One initial QR/mobile order only; no additional orders. Food maximum three, dessert maximum three, drinks including sides maximum five per person. Table-level payment; no separate bills.
Drink coaster applies only to three themed drinks, not side drinks. Reserved-guest postcard set requires actual attendance and menu order; merchandise purchase alone does not qualify.
Ingredients/presentation may change; no takeaway of served food.
